messages:
Alejandra: customer (acme-corp) says console shows $150 promo credits but their API usage is still billing full price. they pasted screenshot and sample request id. can we triage?

Kevin_support: thanks. can you paste the org id + a sample request id + project name? also any headers from the API response (X-Request-Id etc) would help.

Alejandra: org: org_0xACME, project: acme-search, sample request id: rq_20260315_7a9f. user says they did a promo code redemption yesterday morning (promo: MARCHLAUNCH). screenshot shows credits on Console -> Billing -> Credits.

billing-bot: Promo grant event recorded: promo_id=MARCHLAUNCH, grant_id=grant_874, target=ORG:org_0xACME, amount=150.00, timestamp=2026-03-14T09:12:02Z.

Sam_billing: seeing the bot event — the grant was applied to the org-level credit pool, not to the project billing account. console UI surfaces org pool balance, but per-project usage pulls from project-specific allocations. if project isn't linked to the org pool yet, API usage won't consume those credits.

Jen_infra: a few quick repro checks: 1) query billing allocation service: `GET /v1/billing/orgs/org_0xACME/allocations` 2) check usage ledger for project: `SELECT * FROM usage_ledger WHERE project_id='acme-search' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20` 3) verify billing config on project: `GET /v1/projects/acme-search/billing`.

Alejandra: ran the calls, here's the outputs (sanitized):
```
GET /v1/billing/orgs/org_0xACME/allocations -> {"org_pool":150.00, "projects_linked":[]}
GET /v1/projects/acme-search/billing -> {"billing_account":null, "credit_allocation":"none"}
SELECT from usage_ledger -> shows charges applied, no credit_id on entries for acme-search
```

Kevin_support: ok that matches Sam's theory. likely flow: promo created org pool but project hasn't been linked/auto-allocated. Common for customers who create new project after promo grant. two fixes: (A) temporary: manually assign credits to project so API usage consumes them, (B) long-term: add org->project allocation and ensure our console sets up auto-allocation on grant.

Sam_billing: i'll reassign 150 USD from grant_874 to project acme-search as a one-off. i'll post when done. note: this will not retroactively credit past invoices; it will apply to future usage and we can do invoice adjustment if needed after finance review.

Alejandra: please note they reported 3 high-cost requests yesterday (IDs: rq_20260314_a1, rq_20260314_b2, rq_20260314_c3). customer expects those to be covered. we should advise about potential invoice credit if confirmed.

Jen_infra: tagging potential race: allocation sync job sometimes misses newly-created projects for ~10-15m if created immediately after grant. also edge-case where redeem flow writes grant scoped to ORG but console binding fails to create project allocation. i'll open infra ticket to add more visibility to grant->allocation pipeline.

Sam_billing: done — grant reassigned. operation id op_5912. new project balance shows 150.00. I will also create a billing adjustment case for the three requests — need approval from finance.

Alejandra: forwarded to customer with ETA ~4 business hours for manual adjust review. asked them to confirm if they still see API billing after 10 minutes.

Customer (via email pasted by Alejandra): confirmed that immediate subsequent requests show credits applied (response header `X-Credits-Used: 5` appeared). they said thanks.

Kevin_support: please keep this thread for postmortem notes. ACTIONS: 1) Sam open finance adjustment ticket for past charges (include rq ids and op_5912). 2) Jen open infra ticket to improve allocation visibility and add a retry for grant->allocation binding. 3) Support to add a doc blurb in KB: "Why Console shows credits but API doesn't" (explain org pool vs project allocation).

Alejandra: noted and closing with customer success after finance reply. tagging @sam_billing for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
